subject: KMS/HSM evidence request for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ — onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Danielle Brooks <danielle.brooks@finsecure.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: security@finsecure.com, procurement@finsecure.com
Date: 2028-06-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KMS / HSM evidence needed for SOC 2 + SIG onboarding

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As we complete procurement and start the security review I need a compact evidence package focused on encryption and key management so our audit team can sign off. Specifically they asked for:

- Inventory of KMS instances/services used for customer data (regions + tenancy model).
- HSM attestation or vendor statement for any customer-key material operations.
- Key rotation policy (frequency, emergency rotation process).
- Transport encryption flow diagram (how keys are wrapped for transit / cross-region).
- Proof of separation of duties for operators who can rotate/unwrap keys.

If you can provide a one-zip package or a shared Drive folder with the artifacts and a short README, that would be ideal. Targeting our onboarding review on 2028-06-16, so if we can get these by EOD 2028-06-12 that keeps us on schedule.

Also please indicate any items that are redlines (e.g., BYOK limitations) so I can flag to our legal team early.

Thanks,
Danielle
Danielle Brooks
Senior Security Engineer — FinSecure
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle.brooks@finsecure.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS / HSM evidence needed for SOC 2 + SIG onboarding

Hi Danielle — thanks for the clear ask and deadline. We'll assemble a concise package. Quick confirmation of scope from our side so we send only what's helpful:

1) Inventory: we'll include a CSV with active KMS instances and mapped tenancy (hosted/shared/dedicated) and region tags.
2) HSM attestation: we have an HSM vendor statement (FIPS/SOC2 excerpt) and our on-prem BYOK HSM manifest — we'll include an attestation PDF and operator-shift logs (redacted).
3) Rotation policy: our official rotation_policy_v2.md plus a short narrative describing emergency rewrap and cross-region eviction.
4) Transport diagram: a simple SVG/PNG and a short bullet flow describing wrapping (tenant KEK -> envelope keys -> TLS session).
5) Operator separation: we'll include an operator role matrix and a signed statement from our Security Ops lead.

Two questions before we finalize:
- Do you need raw operator shift logs or just sampled excerpts? We can provide sampled logs with timestamps and redaction.
- For BYOK customers, do you require KMS key material provenance or is the acceptance of BYOK process (signed handoff) sufficient?

Plan: assemble in a Drive folder and share link + zip by 2028-06-12 EOD. Attaching a proposed artifact index in this reply.

Attachments (stubs):
- proposed_artifact_index.txt (index of files we'll include)

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Customer Security Intake, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS / HSM evidence needed for SOC 2 + SIG onboarding

Adding a few technical clarifications we should pre-generate for Danielle: 

- HSM attestation: include vendor-signed attestation (date, device serials, firmware version) and our HSM operator access matrix. We'll redact operator personal IDs.
- KMS inventory: include key policy templates and the IAM principals allowed to perform Decrypt/Export/WrapKey.
- Rotation: we rotate tenant KEKs every 90 days by default; envelope keys are ephemeral per session. Add a short table showing last three rotation events per tenant (sample).
- Transit: provide a sequence diagram (client -> TLS terminated at edge -> server KMS wrap -> encrypted payload to compute plane). Explicitly call out in-transit TLS term points and where KMS wrapping occurs.

I'll prepare the diagrams and the rotation-event CSV (redacted). Kimberly — can you export the last-3 rotations sample and the KMS policy templates?

-Jonas
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-10T11:45:00-07:00

Kimberly
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle.brooks@finsecure.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: FW: KMS / HSM evidence needed for SOC 2 + SIG onboarding — package delivered

Danielle — we uploaded the requested artifacts to a shared Drive folder and attached a zip for convenience. Below is a short README with what each file contains and a few callouts.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfG-example
Zip: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1AbCdEfG-example&confirm=yes

README (summary):
- redwood_kms_inventory.csv — list of active KMS endpoints with region, tenancy type (hosted/dedicated/tenant-BYOK), key_policy_reference. (sanitized).
- sample_rotation_events.csv — last 3 rotation events per sampled tenant (timestamps + operator role). No operator PII.
- rotation_policy_v2.md — canonical rotation policy (90-day KEK rotation, emergency rewrap procedures, cross-region eviction steps).
- hsm_attestation_2027-09.pdf — vendor attestation covering FIPS / HSM configuration and audit summary.
- hsm_operator_matrix.xlsx — role matrix and separation of duties (redacted).
- soc2_2027_audit_summary.pdf — high-level auditor summary with control mappings (includes references to KMS/HSM controls).

Redlines / limitations:
- BYOK: we accept customer-provided key material but do not hold nor export private key material. For customers requiring exportable wrapped keys we require an enterprise-signed agreement; this is uncommon for standard onboarding and would be a contractual exception.
- HSM: our hosted offering uses vendor HSMs (vendor attestation included). Dedicated/private BYOK deployments can leverage customer-managed HSMs; in that case we only provide operator runbooks and acceptance tests, not key material.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and let us know if your auditors need deeper artifacts (full shift logs under NDA, raw operator IDs with redaction audit trail). If you want an itemized checklist for procurement/Legal, we can provide that to procurement@finsecure.com.

Thanks — Olga
Attachments (delivered): redwood_kms_inventory.csv, sample_rotation_events.csv, rotation_policy_v2.md, hsm_attestation_2027-09.pdf, hsm_operator_matrix.xlsx, soc2_2027_audit_summary.pdf
